title: Canonical comparison coordinate maps for affine-line purity
statement: Define the following canonical coordinate operations for the affine-line comparison. Use exact comparison $C_T$ [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback], derived inverse image and tensor [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], their canonical monoidal and inverse-image comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback, lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback]. For a symmetric monoidal Grothendieck abelian coefficient category with functorial flat resolutions, the compared degree-zero unit maps canonically isomorphically to the derived pro-etale unit; tensoring this unit comparison and applying the native right unitor defines $K\otimes C_T\mathbf1[0]\cong K$. Given $e:Z\cong K\otimes W$ and $t:W\to C_T\mathbf1[0]$, define tensor integration as $e$ followed by $1_K\otimes t$ and that unitor. For a finite commutative coefficient ring $A$, a positive $N$ killing $A$, and $f:X\to Z$ with $N$ invertible on $Z$, define the compared shifted Tate pullback by applying $C_X$ to the normalized roots-of-unity pullback [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback] with the normalized transport of [def-amb-p1-trace]. For ordinary complexes $K^e$ on $Z$, $W$ on $X$, an actual pro-etale complex $K$ and $e_K:C_ZK^e\cong K$, define $C_X(f_e^*K^e\otimes^L W)\cong Lf^*K\otimes^LC_XW$ by canonical tensor/inverse-image comparison followed by $Lf^*e_K$. For $X=\mathbf A^1_T$ [def-sbc-affine-space], $P=\mathbf P^1_T$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], the standard chart $j$ and projection $q$, and any prescribed trace $t:Rq_*C_PW\to C_TA[0]$, define its restriction $Rp_!C_Xj_e^*W\to C_TA[0]$ using the chosen compactification [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], the canonical inverse-image comparison, then $Rq_*$ of the actual open-extension counit [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero], then $t$. Finally for the existing positive finite quotient coefficients [def-pur-conventions], compose compared shifted Tate pullback with the normalized inverse-limit identification tau of [lem-pur-vector-integration-site-comparison]. These are composites of specified canonical maps, with no arbitrary arrow or orientation choice. For the actual symmetry-adjusted canonical compact-support projection [def-exchange-projection], retain its inverse whenever it is invertible, with the two tensor symmetries in their specified order. The module-coefficient tensor integration uses the literal compared ordinary coefficient unit and the same canonical right unitor. The ordinary and pro-etale source objects in the realization comparison are the literal pullback/tensor objects in its displayed formula. The predicate ProjectionInvertible is exactly invertibility of this specified coefficient-first canonical projection map, and its proof is the input of inverseProjection and projectionTensorTrace. Its inverse-image comparison is [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback], and its canonical tensor comparison is [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback].

reviewed_lean.note: First stage-2 delivery (commit c19b0049: 3 modules, 2 new def nodes; the coordinate-maps record is in the commit, not the snapshot). Clause by clause: Ring P = finiteTateCoefficient(level-1) with ringEquiv, the reindexing already used in SupportedBottomGluing/AffineTranslationTrace; Y separated finite type via aY, Noetherian derived; (j,q) = affineTraceLineCompactification (affineChart, ProjectiveLine projection); t^p = projectiveTrace, and ProjectiveCompatibility gives beta then t^p = C(t^e); integration = Rq_* of the actual openAdjunction counit after the inverse-image comparison, then the trace; Pi_K = inverse of s_Y, PF_c, Rp_!(s_X), the node's order; a_K = inverse projection, 1 tensor integration, canonical unit iso and native right unitor; gamma = specifiedExceptionalHomEquiv with target sfFiniteExceptionalAt, both recorded stmt_dep declarations; the witness is the displayed ordinary p_e^*K^e tensor j_e^*B_P[2] with its canonical comparison. M_K is in tau-coordinates C_X(j_e^*B_P[2]), which the node allows; coefficientTwistIso links it to A_X(1)[2]. Sorry'd coordinate equalities are true by unfold/rfl, so the eqToIso transports are identities. Boundedness, projection_isIso and primeUnit are true. Edge cases: Y empty, n=1, every exponent, K=0, universes unchanged. Statements verbatim (script check); only new def node added to item stmt_deps; no cycle; docstrings and both report sections present; no recompile since no file changed (worker reports 25.4/15.0/10.8 s clean). Advisories: owner nodes outside stmt_deps (finite-site-coordinates, tensor-projection, proetale-affine-line-counit, supported-projective-site-arrows); coefficientFinite duplicates vectorBundlePurityFiniteCoefficient; public priority-2000 coefficientRing instance; unused tensorTrace/moduleTensorTrace/source_eq/ringEquiv/coefficientTwistIso; primeUnit restates a private conventions lemma; independence of gamma from (Ke,eK) rests on thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class.
